summary.text: Says Maughan has supported increasing housing in Corvallis, noting applications for nearly 2,000 new units, including over 500 affordable units.
summary.quote: Charles has always supported more housing in Corvallis. While mayor, Corvallis has seen applications for close to 2,000 new housing units

summary.text: Says Maughan pushed for sound ordinance changes and a downtown vitality plan, which Maughan will implement in the next term.
summary.quote: He pushed for changes to Corvallis’ sound ordinance to support local events and commissioned a task force that developed a plan for downtown vitality.

summary.text: Says Maughan will continue working on sustainability and has supported electric buses and hybrid police cars.
summary.quote: Mayor Maughan will keep working to make Corvallis resilient and sustainable. He has supported the purchase of electric buses, hybrid police cars
